in_marathi.name: Hanish
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hanish हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'han', meaning 'to offer' or 'to give'. Hanish is a name that evokes grace, generosity, and the spirit of giving.
